The '''''Nightbrother''''' was a modified [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]], named and used by the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] during the [[Clone Wars]] and the [[Imperial Era]]. Following Maul's death at the hands of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[2 BBY]], the ''Nightbrother'' was acquired by the [[Spectres]] rebel cell, where it was simply called the '''''Gauntlet'''''.

==Description==
[[File:GauntletSupportRun-SWLSpecOps.png|thumb|250px|left|The ''Nightbrother'' drops an explosive charge while firing its laser cannons.]]
The ''Nightbrother'' was a customized [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]]<ref name="Databank" /> of the [[Kryze Gauntlet ship]] variant.<ref name="SW Kids" /> Customized with a black and red [[color]] scheme, the [[starfighter]] featured rotating wings, a large hull, and was armed with two forward and two rear [[laser cannon]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

==History==
As the leader of the [[Death Watch]] and the rest of the [[Shadow Collective]], Maul used the ''Nightbrother'' as his [[flagship]], commanding his forces from the [[Starship|ship]] in battles during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[campaign against the Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 2" />

Many [[Standard year|years]] later during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the starfighter was still in Maul's service.<ref name="The Holocrons of Fate" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Maul used the ''Nightbrother'' to flee [[Vizsla Keep 09]] after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] group known as the [[Spectres]] managed to free themselves from his captivity. However, Maul was able to perform a [[Force-bond|connection]] with the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] after the two individuals combined their [[holocron]]s. Maul learned that his old enemy [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] still lived.<ref name="The Holocrons of Fate" /> Continuing his pursuit of Kenobi, Maul later used the ''Nightbrother'' to travel with Bridger to the [[planet]] [[Dathomir]]. After summoning the spirits of fallen [[Nightsisters]], Maul learned that Kenobi was hiding on a planet with [[Tatoo I|twin]] [[Tatoo II|suns]].<ref name="Visions and Voices">{{Rebels|Visions and Voices}}</ref>

[[File:MaulGauntletFighter-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Maul departs from Vizsla Keep 09 in the ''Nightbrother''.]]
Maul flew the ''Nightbrother'' to the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], hoping to find and kill his old adversary Kenobi. Bridger also [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|went]] to Tatooine to stop Maul. After Maul's [[death]], he and the [[C1-series astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] used the ship to get back home to [[Chopper Base]] of the [[Phoenix Cell]].<ref name="Twin Suns" /> Bridger later used the ''Nightbrother'' to get the help of [[Clan Wren]] for the Rebels stuck on [[Atollon]] during their [[Battle of Atollon|battle]] against [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Imperial forces]].<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="In the Name Date">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e8-trivia-gallery|text="Narkina 5" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> Bridger, along with the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Mandalorian]] warrior [[Sabine Wren]], and Chopper traveled on the ''Gauntlet'' to [[Yavin 4]], the headquarters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="ITNOTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nightbrother'' first appeared in the comic [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'' 1]]<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" /> before appearing in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="The Holocrons of Fate" />
